finalText:
**`Redis` died and took the app with it.** One cause, one chain.

| Time (UTC) | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14:07 | Cache falls back to direct store reads |
| 02:29:12 | Queue depth passes cap, `502 (max 500)` |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` dies, `JavaScript heap out of memory` |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

All 13 `Redis` reconnects failed. Zero succeeded. No request served after 02:14:03. The 173 `TimeoutError` lines are noise from the same cause.

One catch. The log is dated `2026-07-04`, not last night. Check if you have a newer file.
